# CM24: a source-fixed boundary-extension cocycle and its Frobenius obstruction

2026-10-15 UTC. Bounded author-side paper preflight by EM-N-DEA587,
under Root EM-DVR-FBF223's direction. Canonical CM owner
EM-DIRECT-18F24A and support EM-CM24CONN-63E74C9D remain unchanged.
This is a new local direction, not the preceding degree-six nonauthor
review, not Native DR, and not execution under the RR claim or lease.

**Outcome.** The saved complete target specifies an explicit triangular
extension of the actual rank-two GM solution system plus a constant
channel. Its cocycle, its exact-boundary change of splitting, and its
Frobenius-lift obstruction can all be written without using a value of
Y. The algebraic compatibility proposition below is proved. Neither a
geometric relative-chain realization nor a solution of that obstruction
in a specified arithmetic ring is constructed here. Thus this is a
concrete carrier/obligation, not an evaluation or explanation of Y by
renaming its integral.

## 1. Exact retained source and the scope of the new construction

All mod-p assertions use the ORIGINAL primes p congruent to 13 or 19
modulo 24, p=6m+1, m>=2, N=3m, n=2m, c=1/2. Put

    S(r)=4r^3-3r, q(r)=4r^2-1, P(s)=P_n(s),
    H(r^2)=P(S(r)),
    H_b(x)=g(1+x^N)+(4 sigma/5)x+(sigma/5)x^(N-1),
    sigma=1-2g,
    a(r)=8r^p-4r, w(r)=a(r)/(1-r^2).                 (1)

Here g is the already fixed source constant, not a new parameter; no
division by sigma is made, including when sigma=0. The source quadratic
paper, section 7, gives exactly

    ell(T)=3Y=I_x[(4x^N-2)(H-H_b)/(1-x)](c).          (2)

I_x is its prescribed finite coefficient pairing. Its x-integrand has
degree <=p-3. Under x=r^2 its derivative is the WHOLE polynomial

    f(r)=w(r)(P(S(r))-H_b(r^2)).                     (3)

It is odd of degree <=2p-5. The source primitive is even of degree
<=2p-4, with zero origin. In this degree window the derivative kernel
is generated by 1 and r^p; parity excludes r^p and the origin excludes
1. These conditions belong to the target and cannot be replaced by
the assertion that an arbitrary antiderivative is unique.

Retain the quarter channel as the exact identity

    f=a[S' (P(S)-1)/(1-S^2)
          -4(P(S)-1)/q+(1-H_b(r^2))/(1-r^2)].       (4)

No individual term in (4) is dropped. Its polynomial regularity and
degree bounds refer to the actual source section and its full
cancellations, not every solution of a GM system. In particular this
is not the unweighted response B=W-C_m(1-s^2) from the old quadratic
paper. That response does not replace P-1 in (4).

Source locators: quadratic paper lines 249-304 and 306-387; exact
geometry paper lines 163-248; fixed-boundary residual note equations
(3)-(8). Full filenames and byte pins accompany this note.

## 2. Actual GM module, and an explicit source-fixed extension row

On the s-line with s^2-1 inverted the actual geometry gives the
PERIOD-COLUMN system y_s=A(s)y, where

    A(s)=[[alpha,beta],[gamma,-alpha]],
    alpha=-(2s-1)/(6(s^2-1)),
    beta=-1/(6(s^2-1)),
    gamma=-(4s-5)/(6(s^2-1)).                       (5)

Its scalar operator is L_*=(1-s^2)D_s^2-2sD_s-2/9. Pull this actual
connection back by S, and add a constant channel z:

    D(r)=diag(S'(r)A(S(r)),0), X=(y_1,y_2,z)^T,
    X'=D X,
    b(r)=(w(r),0,-w(r)H_b(r^2)).                    (6)

For example all entries lie in
k[r,(1-r^2)^(-1),q^(-1)] for k=F_p (or its stated endpoint extension).
The new fourth coordinate is defined by the CONNECTION, not by an
assigned target value:

    (X,V)'=N_b(X,V), N_b=[[D,0],[b,0]].              (7)

It is an explicit extension with a constant one-dimensional kernel
and quotient the rank-three system D. In one base variable this
connection is integrable. The WHOLE rank-four object need not be a
unipotent connection: its rank-two GM quotient is retained. Only the
new additive triangular layer is being described. No categorical
universal property or nonsplitting is asserted.

The quarter decomposition is already an equality of ROW cocycles,
before inserting a solution:

    b=a{[S'/(1-S^2)-4/q](1,0,-1)
                          +(1-H_b(r^2))/(1-r^2)(0,0,1)}.            (8)

Thus (7) has not replaced the complete source by a proper-H1 scalar
or erased a baseline. Its coefficients require H_b, but not Y, T's
coefficient array, or an unknown endpoint normalization.

There is an exact MOD-P source section of D. For P=P_n define

    e_P(s)=6(1-s^2)P'(s)+(1-2s)P(s),
    X_P(r)=(P(S(r)),e_P(S(r)),1)^T.                 (9)

Since n(n+1)=-2/9 in F_p, the Legendre equation implies L_*P=0;
the scalar-to-GM change in (5) then proves X_P'=D X_P. Substitution
gives b X_P=f. This proves source compatibility of the new row, not
that X_P is a particular geometric period or that its new V coordinate
has an independently known value. Imposing the source parity/degree/
origin conditions would simply recover the already known coefficient
pairing (2), and supplies no new scalar information about Y.

## 3. Proved gauge-and-boundary proposition

Let R be any specified differential coefficient ring in one variable,
with derivation prime. Let D be a matrix over R and b a row over R.
For any row h over the SAME ring, set V_tilde=V-hX. Direct
differentiation of (7) proves

    b_tilde=b-h'-hD.                               (10)

Consequently b is a split extension row in this chosen category iff
there is such an h with b=h'+hD (for splittings inducing identity on
the specified kernel and quotient). The obstruction is the class of
b in rows modulo the image of h -> h'+hD. Enlarging R by adjoining
a desired primitive is not a proof that this class vanishes in R.

For any declared evaluation endpoints r_0,r_1 where the solution
and the splitting are regular, the EXACT boundary formula is

    [V]_(r_0)^(r_1)
       =[V_tilde]_(r_0)^(r_1)+[hX]_(r_0)^(r_1).     (11)

If a splitting has poles at an endpoint, (11) is not an instruction
to evaluate infinity: one must retain a specified relative/Čech
representative or a separately justified regularization. No such
regularization is silently selected here.

Proof: (10) is (V-hX)'=bX-h'X-hDX. The triangular change of basis is
invertible, with inverse V=V_tilde+hX; hence it proves the stated
splitting equivalence and (11). This is a property of the entire
system, not a fit to a chosen source solution.

This formulation allows an exact-boundary term to be retained rather
than forcing it to disappear inside proper H1. It does NOT repair the
already failed bare adjoint boundary F0: the saved full residual
-wH_b-K0 U and its r^(2p) kernel accounting remain intact. We have not
recomputed that failed ansatz or claimed a new h solving (10).

## 4. Literal geometric primitives and the still-missing relative chain

There are two different bases involved: r is a parameter of the
family, while x is a coordinate ON its elliptic fiber. A base-parameter
extension (7) is not automatically H1(E_s,D_s) for a selected fiber
boundary divisor D_s. The source does not specify that identification.

The actual geometry nevertheless supplies concrete boundary data to
test any proposed identification. Write E_s:y^2=x^3+A_s x+B_s with
A_s=12s-15, B_s=4s^2-28s+22 and omega=dx/(2y), eta=x omega.
Thus A_s'=12 and B_s'=8s-28 in the ambient parameter. Its literal
GM reduction is

    partial_s (omega,eta)^T
       =A(s)(omega,eta)^T+d_x R,
    R=(V_omega/y,V_eta/y)^T,
    V_omega=-beta x^2+alpha x-2A_s beta/3,
    V_eta=alpha x^2+gamma x+(12+4A_s alpha)/6.       (12)

V2 correction: V1 incorrectly printed B_s=24-28s here. That is only
the VALUE obtained after imposing s^2=1/2 and is not the family on
which ambient differentiation or s=S(r) is performed. Root identified
this error. V1 and its frozen manifest are retained unchanged. The
correct family is the exact geometry source (1); no relation s^2=1/2
is imposed anywhere in the present parameter/chain calculation.

The displayed V_omega,V_eta and A(s) were already the formulas for the
correct full family and remain unchanged. Here is the explicit paper
recheck, rather than merely changing its name. Put a=12s-15,
b=4s^2-28s+22 and d=s^2-1. With (5), direct multiplication gives

    4a alpha-6b beta
      =[-(2/3)a(2s-1)+b]/d=-12=-a',
    18b alpha+4a^2 beta
      =[-3b(2s-1)-(2/3)a^2]/d
      =[-24s^3+84s^2+24s-84]/d=-3(8s-28)=-3b',
    (a'+4a alpha)/6=b beta, gamma=(a/3)beta.         (12a)

For f=x^3+ax+b, writing a prime on V here for its x-derivative,
the cleared identities are

    4 V_omega' f-2 V_omega f_x
       =-(a'x+b')-2(alpha+beta x)f,
    4 V_eta' f-2 V_eta f_x
       =-x(a'x+b')-2(gamma-alpha x)f.               (12b)

The x^4,x^3,x^2 terms follow from the displayed V coefficients;
the remaining terms reduce to (12a). Dividing by 4y^3 proves BOTH
literal differential identities in (12), since
partial_s omega=-(a'x+b')dx/(4y^3) with b'=8s-28 and
partial_s eta=x partial_s omega. This is a full-parameter identity
on the original smooth base with s^2-1 inverted, not a halfpoint
specialization and not an inference from a cohomology-class equality.
No numerical or symbolic-algebra program was run for this correction.

For a legitimate moving relative chain with boundary P_1(s)-P_0(s),
the period column I has a boundary correction

    I'=A I+c_D,
    c_D=Delta_D(R+iota_(moving endpoint) (omega,eta)^T).             (13)

This is the ordinary chain differentiation/product rule, conditional
on an actual differentiable pairing/relative realization. For fixed-x
sections away from y=0 the contraction term is zero and
c_D=R(P_1)-R(P_0). A constant channel homogenizes (13). This gives an
explicit possible relative extension cocycle from the SAVED literal
primitives, without choosing endpoints from Y. It does not say those
sections or that chain have been selected by the source. More general
boundary divisors can require more constant channels.

Likewise the already proved conjugate 3-isogeny has the literal rule

    j_s^*(omega_-s,eta_-s)^T
       =J^T(omega_s,eta_s)^T+d_x q_j,
    J=nu[[1,2],[0,-1]],
    q_j=(0,-(2/nu)y/(x-3))^T.                      (14)

It therefore contributes Delta_D q_j to a relative pairing, unless
that difference is independently proved to vanish. The primitive has
poles at the known kernel divisor, including infinity; a chain meeting
those poles requires the relative principal-part data. The genuine
Frobenius analogue would need its OWN literal primitive q_F and an
action on the boundary divisor/chain. Neither J nor a matrix on proper
H1 supplies q_F. Equations (12)-(14) identify concrete data that the
proper quotient forgets; they are not newly selected geometric cycles.

## 5. Frobenius compatibility: an explicit equation, not a chosen lift

For this paragraph choose a characteristic-zero differential ring R
with a specified coefficient endomorphism sigma, base lift phi, and
allowed arithmetic category (for example an explicitly chosen rigid
function ring AFTER inverting p). Assume it is stable under the
displayed operations. Tildes for chosen lifts of D,b are suppressed.
The mod-p row (6) alone does not determine these lifts or an integral
lattice. Define, with the chain-rule factor in ONE-forms,

    D_phi=phi' sigma(D)(phi), b_phi=phi' sigma(b)(phi),
    h_phi=sigma(h)(phi).                            (15)

h_phi is a ZERO-form and has no extra factor phi'. Suppose an actual
base comparison F_D is supplied in the solution-transport direction

    X(r)=F_D(r) sigma(X)(phi(r)),
    F_D'=D F_D-F_D D_phi.                           (16)

For clarity, if a cohomology Frobenius matrix M satisfies
M'+C M=M C_phi in the column-of-classes convention, then the matching
solution transport is (M^T)^(-1), AFTER inverting p; it is not M or
M^T in the same direction. No integral inverse is assumed. Constants
in the base z channel use their specified constant comparison.

An extension comparison preserving this filtration must have the form

    F_ext=[[F_D,0],[u,lambda]],
    lambda'=0,
    u'+uD_phi=b F_D-lambda b_phi.                   (17)

Here lambda is part of the SPECIFIED Frobenius structure on the new
constant connection, not a scalar to fit from Y. If that graded object
is prescribed as the unit F-isocrystal, lambda=1. A different Tate
weight must be justified by the relative realization, not chosen to
make (17) solvable. Invertibility needs F_D invertible and lambda
nonzero in the declared category.

Proposition: (17) is necessary and sufficient for this block matrix
to obey F_ext'=N_b F_ext-F_ext (N_b)_phi. Under (10), it transforms as

    u_tilde=u-h F_D+lambda h_phi,                   (18)

and obeys the same equation with b_tilde. Thus the actual obstruction
is the class of b F_D-lambda b_phi modulo rows u'+uD_phi in the
chosen ring, with the allowed boundary normalization also retained.

Proof: multiply the four blocks; the upper-left equation is (16),
the lower-right equation is lambda'=0, and the lower-left equation
is (17). With G=[[I,0],[-h,1]], the new comparison is
G F_ext (G_phi)^(-1), giving (18). Differentiating (18) and using
(16) cancels h F_D D_phi and leaves exactly the right side formed
with b-h'-hD. This also proves that ignoring the boundary change is
not an invariant operation. As a useful sufficient subcase, when
b=h'+hD, the explicit row u=h F_D-lambda h_phi solves (17), with
the boundary contribution in (11); this does not assert such an h
for the present source.

Local formal integration in an enlarged field is not arithmetic
existence: poles, convergence, p-denominators, global gluing and the
source endpoint normalization remain substantive requirements. An
unknown integration constant cannot be set equal to Y as a solution
of this problem. The halfpoint identity sigma(zeta)=-zeta also does
not choose an ambient phi or its derivative.

## 6. A precise lift barrier before this equation can determine the target

The field section (9) cannot be silently promoted to mod p^2. The
existing spectral paper gives, exactly in scalar coefficients,

    n(n+1)=(-2+p+p^2)/9,
    L_* P_n=-delta_p P_n, delta_p=p(p+1)/9.          (19)

For the SAME definition of e_P over the p-local rational coefficients,
eliminating the derivative in (5) gives

    (P_n,e_P)'=[A+[[0,0],[-6 delta_p,0]]](P_n,e_P). (20)

Indeed the second-equation error is L_*P_n/[beta(1-s^2)]
=6L_*P_n, which proves both the sign and factor in (20). It vanishes
mod p but generally not mod p^2. The known finite Q_* repair solves
L_*Q_*=0 modulo p^2, but replacing P_n by Q_* changes the target
channel unless its complete difference, baseline and relative
boundary are also accounted for. That replacement is not made here.
This uses the already saved spectral correction, not a new proof of
the earlier p-small extension or of a complete geometric period.

Similarly (a(r))'=-4 holds only after reduction; the literal lift has
derivative 8p r^(p-1)-4. A mod-p primitive identity cannot be inserted
into (17) modulo p^2 after suppressing that term. The full prescribed
source lifts, including the baseline and source normalization, must
be chosen before a p-adic target comparison can be asserted.

## 7. What is now testable, and what remains open

The new concrete object is (6)-(8), with the proved splitting/boundary
law (10)-(11) and the exact arithmetic obstruction (17)-(18). No free
coefficient, period ratio or target initial value was introduced.
The construction may carry boundary information; it has not proved
that the relevant obstruction vanishes or that the whole target is
a geometric relative period.

A decisive next step would have to supply ONE source-compatible
relative realization/lift, its actual boundary/chain and normalization,
then exhibit u in its specified ring satisfying (17), with the
literal terms (12)-(14) and the lift correction (19)-(20) respected.
That is a concrete equation plus a geometric comparison obligation,
not a request for more unlocated literature or a generic condition
inventory. Failure of a particular realization or ring would only
reject that construction, not the original objective.

## 2. Whole source, rank, quarter row, and the mod-p section

For every original p=6m+1 congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24, all scalar
denominators 2,3,5,9 used here are units. The original target, including
the fixed H_b and sigma=1-2g, is retained without dividing by sigma.
There is no hypothesis sigma != 0 or target-value fit.

The cubic pullback has

    1-S^2=(1-r^2)q^2, S'=3q,
    S'/(1-S^2)-4/q=1/(1-r^2).

Consequently (8), as a ROW identity, is exactly
b=(w,0,-w H_b). In particular its third component is
-a/(1-r^2)+a(1-H_b)/(1-r^2)=-w H_b, not a discarded constant.
The quarter term is present before any source section is inserted.
This does not make every summand regular on every free solution.

N_b=[[D,0],[b,0]] is rank four, with constant rank-one kernel and
rank-three quotient D=diag(S'A(S),0). Integrability in this one-variable
connection setting follows because its curvature has no two-form
component. It is not a statement of zero p-curvature, a categorical
universal property, or unipotence of the retained rank-two GM module.
The paper correctly makes none of those stronger claims.

From the first period equation y_1'=alpha y_1+beta y_2,

    (P'-alpha P)/beta
       =6(1-s^2)P'+(1-2s)P=e_P.

Since n(n+1)=-2/9 modulo p, the second equation follows from L_*P=0.
Thus X_P=(P(S),e_P(S),1) is genuinely horizontal modulo p and bX_P=f.
This does not identify X_P with a selected geometric cycle or supply
its new fourth-coordinate value.

The source degree/parity assertions are consistent with the old target:
the x integrand has degree <=p-3; substitution dx=2r dr produces
a=8r^p-4r and an odd polynomial f of degree <=2p-5. Its prescribed
primitive is even of degree <=2p-4 and zero at the origin. In that
window a derivative-zero polynomial is c_0+c_1 r^p. The odd monomial
r^p is excluded by even parity and c_0 by the origin condition. No
ordinary integration argument has erased a characteristic-p kernel.
These assertions concern the complete source, not arbitrary GM data.

## 3. Splitting, ring scope, and literal boundaries

Directly differentiating V_tilde=V-hX gives

    V_tilde'=(b-h'-hD)X.

The triangular matrix [[I,0],[-h,1]] has its displayed inverse over the
same ring. Therefore the stated splitting equivalence is exact for
splittings inducing identity on the declared kernel and quotient.
Rows modulo the image h -> h'+hD are understood as the appropriate
additive/differential-cohomology quotient; the image is not being
asserted to be an R-submodule for arbitrary scalars of a differential
ring. Adjoining an antiderivative changes the category and proves no
splitting in the original ring.

At legal endpoints, V=V_tilde+hX gives the plus boundary term in (11).
The paper expressly retains relative/Čech data if h has poles. It does
not assign infinity an endpoint value or claim that the failed old bare
boundary has now succeeded. The saved residual and r^(2p) accounting
remain old, unchanged constraints.

## 4. V2 ambient-family correction and the literal GM check

V1 used the halfpoint value B_s=24-28s as an ambient family. That was a
real error: ambient differentiation requires

    a=12s-15, b=4s^2-28s+22, a'=12, b'=8s-28.

V2 now uses these values without imposing s^2=1/2. I independently
checked its new scalar identities. With d=s^2-1,

    -(2/3)a(2s-1)+b=-12d,
    -3b(2s-1)-(2/3)a^2
       =-24s^3+84s^2+24s-84=-3(8s-28)d.

They imply 4a alpha-6b beta=-a' and
18b alpha+4a^2 beta=-3b'. Also
v_0=-2a beta/3, v_1=(a'+4a alpha)/6=b beta,
and gamma=a beta/3, exactly as in the fixed old full-family geometry.

For completeness, I checked every x coefficient of the two new cleared
identities, not only a cohomology class. For V_omega=-beta x^2+alpha x+v_0,
the coefficient list of 4V_omega' f-2V_omega f_x in descending degree is

    -2beta, -2alpha, -2a beta,
    2a alpha-8b beta, 4b alpha+4a^2 beta/3.

The two scalar identities above change its last two entries into
-a'-2a alpha-2b beta and -b'-2b alpha. This is precisely
-(a'x+b')-2(alpha+beta x)f.

For V_eta=alpha x^2+gamma x+v_1, the coefficient list is

    2alpha, -2gamma, 6a alpha-6v_1,
    8b alpha+2a gamma, 4b gamma-2a v_1.

Using the same identities and v_1=b beta, gamma=a beta/3 gives exactly
-x(a'x+b')-2(gamma-alpha x)f. Dividing by 4y^3 has the correct factor,
because d_x(V/y)=(4V'f-2Vf_x)dx/(4y^3). Thus the literal differential
statement is valid on the full smooth base, with its stated rational
representatives. The known V1 mustfix is removed in V2. This local
coefficient audit does not retroactively PASS V1 or replace the earlier
distinct review of the old geometry input.

The conditional moving-chain correction (13) has the correct sign:
the exact GM primitive contributes Delta_D R, while motion of the
boundary contributes Delta_D iota_v(omega,eta)^T. At fixed-x sections
away from y=0 the latter term is zero. This is an interface for an
actually specified relative pairing, not evidence that such endpoints
or a chain have been selected for the target.

For the saved 3-isogeny, columns of cohomology classes give period-form
matrix J^T. The primitive q_j=(0,-(2/nu)y/(x-3))^T has the stated sign
and scale. Its poles at the kernel divisor/infinity cannot be erased in
a relative pairing. A Frobenius primitive q_F and its boundary action
are not supplied by that proper-H1 matrix. V2 keeps this missing datum
explicit rather than identifying j with Frobenius.

## 5. Conditional Frobenius block proposition and variance

Here the declared setting is a differential arithmetic ring with a
coefficient endomorphism sigma and base map phi. As usual for the
coefficient/base separation in (15), sigma acts on coefficients and
the pullback has the differential chain rule

    (sigma(h)(phi))'=phi' sigma(h')(phi).

Without that differential-pullback meaning, the proposed operations
would not define the stated connection pullback; V2 does not assert
the proposition for an arbitrary unrelated ring endomorphism. It
does not choose the arithmetic ring, lattice, lifts or normalization.

D_phi and b_phi are one-form coefficients and carry phi'. h_phi is a
zero-form, so adding another phi' to it would be wrong. With the
assumed quotient transport F_D'=D F_D-F_D D_phi, block multiplication
gives

    N_b F_ext-F_ext (N_b)_phi
      =[[D F_D-F_D D_phi,0],
        [b F_D-uD_phi-lambda b_phi,0]].

This proves both necessity and sufficiency of lambda'=0 and (17) for
the displayed block matrix. Invertibility additionally requires the
stated invertibility of F_D and lambda. A unit graded F-isocrystal
has lambda=1; a different weight requires its own realization and
cannot be selected by a target value.

Under the source and target splitting changes,

    G F_ext (G_phi)^(-1)
      =[[F_D,0],[u-hF_D+lambda h_phi,lambda]].

Differentiating the lower-left row and adding its product with D_phi
gives

    (b-h'-hD)F_D
       -lambda(b_phi-(h_phi)'-h_phi D_phi),

which is precisely the equation with the transformed row. The
positive lambda h_phi sign and the minus hF_D sign are correct.
For b=h'+hD, the sufficient special solution
u=hF_D-lambda h_phi follows by the same calculation. It asserts no
such h for this source and no solution u in an allowed arithmetic ring.

I also checked the variance distinction explicitly. If a class-column
matrix M obeys M'+CM=M C_phi, then differentiating F=(M^T)^(-1)
gives F'=C^T F-F C_phi^T. Thus the solution-column connection uses
F, not M in the same direction. Its inverse is only asserted after
inverting p; no integral inverse is smuggled into the statement.

## 6. Source-section lifting barrier and the limits of PASS

The new placement of the old spectral displacement is correct:

    n(n+1)=(-2+p+p^2)/9,
    L_*P_n=-delta_p P_n, delta_p=p(p+1)/9.

Elimination of the first GM equation for the SAME e_P gives a second
row defect L_*P/[beta(1-s^2)]. Since beta=1/[6(1-s^2)], this is
6L_*P=-6delta_p P. Hence (20) has the correct negative sign, factor
six, and lower-left position. P_n is horizontal modulo p but cannot
silently serve as that same horizontal section modulo p^2. The saved
Q_* repair is not inserted without its target/baseline difference.

Likewise (8r^p-4r)'=-4 only modulo p; its literal derivative is
8p r^(p-1)-4. The halfpoint relation sigma(zeta)=-zeta does not choose
an ambient base lift, a first jet, or its action on a relative chain.
V2 correctly leaves those independent requirements in place.

The accepted increment is therefore exactly an explicit source-fixed
rank-four connection carrier, its retained baseline/quarter row, the
gauge-boundary proposition, and the conditional block Frobenius
obstruction. It is not a new target evaluation obtained by naming its
primitive V, and it is not a proof that its obstruction is nonzero.
The source section is a concrete modulo-p section, not an identified
geometric period.
